clue.text: Feeling ill during balloon trip at dusk

indicators.note: one piece sits during, that is inside, the span of the other

parts.note: a trip in a balloon is a flight
ailing means feeling ill

explanation.surface: Someone takes a sunset balloon ride and comes over queasy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'during' puts AILING inside FLIGHT, between its F and the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Dusk is when daylight fades and the sky grows dim, so the phrase describes evening's dwindling brightness.

clue.text: An Indian city initially motivating muddled characters

parts.note: Agra is the Indian city of the Taj Mahal

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word motivating

explanation.surface: A traveller describes what drove them to visit a city in India.
explanation.definitionFit: An anagram is a word whose letters, or characters, have been jumbled up.

clue.text: Unfinished business Oscar noticed in Lydda

indicators.note: the two words before in are placed inside the town's name

parts.note: Lydda is the old name of Lod, a town in Israel
Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet
noticed means seen

explanation.surface: Some matter left hanging was spotted by a man called Oscar in an ancient town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts O and SEEN inside LOD, after its LO.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter still to be tied up is an idiomatic item of business left incomplete.

clue.text: Governor Macquarrie revealed a standard of behaviour

indicators.note: revealed says the letters are on show within the words Governor Macquarrie

explanation.surface: A colonial governor set an example of proper conduct.
explanation.walkthrough: Lachlan Macquarie was an early governor of New South Wales, which helps the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is a usual or expected pattern of conduct in a group.

clue.text: No Blairite compromised freedom

indicators.note: compromised means weakened or broken up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A political comment that freedom was undermined by someone opposed to Tony Blair.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blairite is a follower of Tony Blair, a UK Labour prime minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberation is the act of setting free, synonymous with freedom.

clue.text: Sail English knight into Indian state

indicators.note: into says the two short pieces go inside the state name

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A traveller sails with an English knight to a part of India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts E and N inside GOA after its G.
explanation.definitionFit: A genoa is a large jib, a triangular foresail on a yacht.

clue.text: Sextet entering competition that's inconsequential

indicators.note: entering means one piece goes into the middle of the other

parts.note: a trial is a competitive test, as in sheepdog trials
a sextet is six, VI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A group of six musicians enters a contest of little importance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts VI inside TRIAL, after TRI.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trivial is of slight importance, a near synonym.

clue.text: Kind offer to pick up Edward

parts.note: to tender is to offer
to pick up a sound is to hear it
Ted is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: A generous proposal to collect a man named Edward.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft-hearted, compassionate person is kind.

clue.text: Sacred belief in control over motor race

indicators.note: in a down answer the piece over sits above, so it comes first

parts.note: a rein is a means of control
motor is a word for a car
a race of people can be a nation

explanation.surface: A devout faith in governing a car contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebirth of the soul in a new body is a religious doctrine held in faiths such as Hinduism.

clue.text: Manure scattered round old entrance

indicators.note: round means the jumbled letters go around another piece
scattered means the letters of manure are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Muck strewn around an old doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scattered' turns MANURE into ENAMUR, and 'round' puts O inside it after ENAM.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone, as a verb, is to captivate them, which is what enamour means.

clue.text: Bishop working with enthusiasm creates beacon

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
on means working, as a machine that is on
fire means passion or enthusiasm

explanation.surface: A zealous clergyman lights a signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A large outdoor blaze was used as a signal fire on a hilltop.

clue.text: German beset by woeful lament

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by, so one piece is enclosed

parts.note: dire means dreadful or woeful

explanation.surface: A German surrounded by a sorrowful mourning song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beset by' puts G inside DIRE, after DIR.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirge is a mournful song for the dead, a funeral lament.

clue.text: Making an erotic collage

indicators.note: a collage is a pasted jumble, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An artist assembles a racy collage.
explanation.definitionFit: Creation is the act of making or producing something.

clue.text: One suggesting what's right about 'Arry

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: proper means right or correct
to harry is to hound; the apostrophe shows a Cockney dropped H

explanation.surface: Someone proposes what is correct concerning a Cockney called Harry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts OUND inside PROPER, after PROP. 'Arry is Harry with a Cockney (London working-class) dropped H, so its synonym HOUND loses its H too.
explanation.definitionFit: To propound is to put forward an idea, so one who propounds is a proposer.

clue.text: Men are true when prepared for reward

indicators.note: prepared suggests made ready in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A claim that loyal men should be rewarded when ready.
explanation.definitionFit: To remunerate is to pay someone for work, a synonym of reward as a verb.

clue.text: A fairy returned a jumper

indicators.note: returned means the word for the fairy is turned back to front

parts.note: an elf is a small fairy creature

explanation.surface: A sprite gave back a sweater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns ELF into FLE; A follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A flea is an insect famous for leaping, hence a jumper.

clue.text: Almost has convulsions about painting, sculpture etc

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other

parts.note: fits are convulsions or seizures
near means almost, as in a near disaster

explanation.surface: Someone nearly has seizures over artworks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts NEAR inside FITS, after FI.
explanation.definitionFit: The visual arts such as painting and sculpture are collectively known by this phrase.

clue.text: Smallest doesn't start in this direction

indicators.note: doesn't start means the opening letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: least means smallest

explanation.surface: The tiniest one fails to begin heading this way.
explanation.definitionFit: East is a compass bearing, one way to head.

clue.text: Frank is after soldier

parts.note: since means after, as in since the war
RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for a soldier

explanation.surface: A man named Frank follows a soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sincere is honest and open, as a frank person is.

clue.text: Antagonism in workplace?

parts.note: split as work, which is OP (opus), a musical work
split as place, which is a position

explanation.surface: Hostility in the office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'workplace' is split in two: work gives OP and place gives POSITION.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposition is resistance or hostility, the state of being against something.

clue.text: Establish popular cereals

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
grain is the collective word for cereal crops

explanation.surface: Popular breakfast cereals become fixed habits.
explanation.definitionFit: To ingrain a habit is to fix it firmly, to make it established.

clue.text: Conduct a session in a small car

parts.note: to run something is to conduct or manage it
a bout is a spell or session of activity

explanation.surface: Someone holds a meeting inside a tiny car.
explanation.definitionFit: A runabout is a light car for short trips.

clue.text: Crow seeing snake resting on stone

indicators.note: in a down answer the first piece rests on top of the second

parts.note: a boa is a large snake
ST is the abbreviation for stone, a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A bird spots a snake lying on a rock.
explanation.walkthrough: Stone is a British unit of weight (14 lb), abbreviated ST.
explanation.definitionFit: To crow is to brag, as boasting does.

clue.text: A number in authority having week off

indicators.note: off means the named letter is taken away

parts.note: weight means influence or authority

explanation.surface: Someone in power taking a week's holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight is a numeral, one of the numbers.

clue.text: Knight has time in jail

indicators.note: has means the title holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: Sir is the title of a knight

explanation.surface: A knight serves a prison sentence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' puts T inside SIR, after S. STIR is slang for prison.
explanation.definitionFit: Stir is informal slang for prison.

clue.text: Dodgy dealer hides minute stone

indicators.note: hides means the jumbled letters enclose another piece
dodgy means unreliable, so the letters of dealer are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shady trader conceals a tiny gem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dodgy' turns DEALER into EERALD, and 'hides' puts M inside after E. Dodgy is British slang for dishonest.
explanation.definitionFit: An emerald is a green gemstone.

clue.text: Storm cut through a fleece

parts.note: torn means cut or ripped
to do someone is to cheat or fleece them

explanation.surface: A gale slices through sheep's wool.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent rotating windstorm.

clue.text: Start breaking in? That's bold!

parts.note: to enter on something is to start it
prising means forcing open, as a burglar breaking in does

explanation.surface: A burglar admires their own nerve in forcing entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An enterprising person is adventurous and daring, hence bold.
